conversation.user: I'm planning a backyard office. I have about 420 sq. ft. of exterior wall area, want 10-inch walls, and I care more about speed than hands-on mixing.
conversation.assistant:
For a backyard office with 420 square feet of exterior wall area and a 10-inch thickness, you will need roughly 10 to 11 cubic meters of material. Since you value speed over mixing, I strongly recommend using pre-cast hempcrete blocks, which arrive fully cured and ready to lay, cutting your installation time way down. 

Are you leaning toward a 12-inch wall for maximum thermal performance, or keeping it at 10 inches to maximize your interior floor space?
